groups.title: Management Systems
groups.description: Certified systems that govern how we plan, produce and release every batch.

items.name: ISO 9001:2015
items.scope: Quality management system covering design, manufacture and supply of wires, cables, cordsets and wire harnesses.

items.name: ISO 14001:2015
items.scope: Environmental management system covering the Surat manufacturing facility.

groups.title: Product Approvals
groups.description: Approvals held against the product standards our customers specify.

items.name: BIS Licence — IS 694
items.scope: PVC insulated single core cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.

items.name: TUV / EN 50618
items.scope: Halogen-free cross-linked DC cable for photovoltaic systems, 1.5 kV DC.

items.name: Cordset Safety Approvals
items.scope: Plug and connector approvals held per destination market for moulded cordsets.

groups.title: Material Compliance
groups.description: Declarations covering restricted substances in the compounds and metals we buy.

items.name: RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU
items.scope: Restriction of hazardous substances across insulation compounds, metals and plating.

items.name: REACH SVHC Declaration
items.scope: Substances of very high concern declaration for supplied materials.

testing.name: Conductor resistance
testing.detail: Measured against the class and size limits in IS 8130 / IEC 60228 on every production lot.

testing.name: High voltage (spark & hipot) test
testing.detail: In-line spark testing during extrusion, plus hipot on finished cordsets and harnesses.

testing.name: Insulation resistance
testing.detail: Checked after water immersion for the durations the relevant product standard calls for.

testing.name: Tensile & elongation
testing.detail: Insulation and sheath compounds tested before and after thermal ageing.

testing.name: Flammability
testing.detail: Single-wire flame testing to IEC 60332-1 for flame-retardant constructions.

testing.name: Dimensional inspection
testing.detail: Wall thickness, eccentricity and overall diameter verified against the approved drawing.

testing.name: Crimp pull-off force
testing.detail: Crimp height and pull-off force recorded against specification for harness terminations.

testing.name: Continuity & mis-wire
testing.detail: 100% continuity and mis-wire testing on finished harnesses and cordsets.
